SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_file_size_per_scan_minute
FROM scans AS sc
JOIN sites AS s
  ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
  AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL
  AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL
  AND sc.spanmin <> 0
GROUP BY s.riskeval;
